theorems.statement: DensityAndTangentCones → ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (p : Euclid (n + k)) (lams : ℕ → ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → R.Represents T → p ∈ T.support → (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (sub : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (RC : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n), StrictMono sub ∧ IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes C ∧ IsConeCurrent C ∧ RC.Represents C ∧ ∀ f : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((lams (sub j))⁻¹ ^ n) • R.measure.map (dilation p (lams (sub j))))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂RC.measure))
